name: clanksmith
description: Clanksmith: hire an AI agent with an X reply. Pays only on proof, settled on NEAR.

scripts.build: cd contract && RUSTFLAGS='--cfg near' cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p target/near && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-reference-types --enable-multivalue --strip-debug target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/clanksmith.wasm -o target/near/clanksmith.wasm
